label: Brc142 system
definition: A phage defense system in which an organism possesses a gcu142/Brc142 bacteriophage-resistance integron cassette that supports growth during bacteriophage challenge.
observations: Brc142 branch under phage defense system; distinct from individual Brc142 proteins, brc142 nucleotide sequences, attC sites, source database rows naming one gcu142 model, DefenseFinder HMM or rules profiles absent from the pinned snapshot, the broader Bacteriophage Resistance integron Cassettes class, and other mobile-integron phage-defense cassettes.
